invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so it's expected that result is not null if the execution reaches the exit point.
HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to have non-null write statuses as part of its result payload.
Contractually, methods usually expect the list of input records to be non-null.
The instantTime parameter typically represents a commit/transaction instant and is expected to be non-null.
A non-null context is necessary for distributed computation or execution environments.
